claims.evidence: Badge on side is visible but text is illegible in the photo; no clear model markings or serial plate shown.
No import documents, shipping labels, or markings showing origin are visible in the photos.
No video or audio of the engine running; photos only show a static, disconnected engine with loose hoses/wires.
No hour meter or service log visible in the photos.
Internal components (pistons, turbo, injectors) are not visible; heavy external rust and disconnected wiring give no indication either way.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run despite claim of 'tested and working'
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting, idling, and running under load with visible exhaust and stable sound

risks.risk: Model/brand cannot be confirmed (badge illegible), so engine may not be a genuine Detroit 671
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the legible badge/serial plate and matching engine block casting numbers
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded industrial diesel engine, not as Detroit 671

risks.risk: Internal wear or missing components not visible externally
risks.proof: Video of valve cover/rocker arm removal or borescope footage of cylinders
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible missing/worn internal parts

risks.risk: Heavy rust and oil staining may indicate long-term outdoor neglect, contradicting 'low mileage' claim
risks.proof: Close-up photos of engine serial/data plate with hour meter, plus maintenance records

risks.risk: Loose/disconnected wiring and gauges suggest electrical system may be incomplete or faulty
risks.proof: Photo/video showing wiring harness fully connected and gauges reading during operation

risks.risk: Possible leaks (oil/coolant) not visible in static photos
risks.proof: Video of engine running for several minutes showing no fluid leaks underneath

risks.risk: Compatibility with the generator canopy shown may not be confirmed (could be separate/mismatched items)
risks.proof: Photo showing engine mounted/coupled inside the canopy with alignment to generator head
risks.if_unproven: priced as standalone engine only, not as a matched genset

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the legible engine badge/serial plate
Video of the engine starting and running under load with sound
Close-up of hour meter or any service/maintenance documentation
Photo of wiring harness and gauges fully connected
Video showing engine running without leaks underneath
Photo showing engine coupled to the generator canopy if sold as a set
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a rusted, unverified industrial diesel engine with multiple unproven seller claims (brand, origin, condition, running status); price it at worst case as a non-running, unbranded industrial engine until the listed proofs are provided.
